results.subject: How do I change my website logo?
results.reply_body:
Hi Maria,

To replace the default logo, log in to the Admin Area, go to Settings → General Settings, and open the Brand Images tab. In the Website Logo section click “Replace Image” and upload your own logo. If you want to start fresh, click the red X to delete the current logo first and then upload a new one. The uploaded image will replace the default logo.

Brilliant Directories Support

results.subject: Adding a new membership plan
results.reply_body:
Hi Tom,

Here’s how to add a new paid membership level and set its price:
1. Log in to the admin area and go to Finance » Membership Plans.
2. Click Add New (or edit an existing plan) to open the editor.
3. Open the Sign Ups & Upgrades tab.
4. Set Account Type to a paid option (not Free).
5. Enter the desired Sign‑up price in the pricing fields.
6. Save the plan.
7. Optionally view the public sign‑up page to confirm the price.

If you run into any issues, let us know.

Brilliant Directories Support

Helpful article:
- How to Create New Membership Plans - Add Free or Paid Membership Plans: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046487-how-to-create-new-membership-plans-add-free-or-paid-membership-plans
